summary: Iteration 5 — Channel Manager integrations. Backend: 17/17 pytest tests pass (providers catalog, Kross missing/fake creds error handling, Guesty not_configured stub, full iCal flow create→test→import→link→sync→modify→cancel→idempotency→conflict 400, credentials masking, DELETE preserves cm_reservations, and sync does NOT touch db.events or cleaning collections). Frontend: full E2E via Playwright verified — /integrations page, 2 tabs, add-dialog with provider select, Kross transparency note + hotel_id/username/password fields, Guesty missing_requirements warning, iCal create + card + test-connection-dialog (Connessione riuscita), import properties, mappings section, reservations tab with all filters, mobile 390px layout usable.

minor.issue: cm_property_mappings owned by the deleted connection are left orphaned (their connection_id no longer exists). Reservations preserved correctly (as spec'd), but mappings become dead rows. Consider deleting mappings on connection delete, or exposing an admin cleanup. 3 orphans were cleaned manually during teardown.

action_items: Consider deleting cm_property_mappings when a connection is deleted (currently orphaned).
Optional: expose a friendlier connection_name field in the Kross fake-credentials test flow — current response includes provider detail properly, no blocking issue.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/integrations.py delete_connection removes only cm_connections; orphan cm_property_mappings persist. Either cascade-delete mappings or surface them so admin can garbage-collect.

sync_service._upsert_reservation writes structure_id from mapping into every reservation, but if the property is not yet mapped (unlinked), structure_id stays None and reservations still get created. That's fine, but the reservations endpoint filter by structure_id will silently miss them until relink — worth documenting.

integrations/channel_managers/kross.py uses time.sleep(0.08–0.12) inside asyncio.to_thread loops; acceptable but for hotels with many bookings the linear 1-per-day arrivals scan could get slow (see _fetch_sync). Consider pagination fallback only when 'search-reservation' probe fails once, not per-property.

IntegrationsPage.js does not disable the 'Sincronizza ora' button when the connection has zero linked mappings — clicking still triggers backend which returns errors=['Nessuna struttura collegata...']. Toast surfaces it correctly, but UX-wise the button could be disabled or badge shown.
Password field placeholder ('Impostata — lascia vuoto per non modificare') is only shown in edit mode — correct. Confirmed masked value '••••••••' is never leaked to the frontend list payload.
seed_data_creation: During tests: TEST_KROSS_EMPTY, TEST_KROSS_FAKE, TEST_GUESTY, TEST_ICAL_FLOW, TEST_ICAL_CONFLICT, TEST_ICAL_DELETE (backend) and TEST_FE_ICAL (frontend). All deleted at teardown; 3 orphan cm_property_mappings from deleted connections were also removed manually. cm_reservations and cm_property_mappings collections are now empty. Real structures (KLV-0001/2/3) untouched — booking_source restored to 'manual' where tests had temporarily set it to 'ical'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_integrations_channel_managers.py. Run with '-o addopts=""' to bypass xdist parallelism because TestICalFlow is sequential (module-scoped conn_id shared across ordered tests). It boots a per-worker http.server on a free port serving a synthetic .ics feed under /app/backend/tests/_ical_tmp — dates are computed relative to today() so it stays valid indefinitely. Kross fake-credentials test hits apiapp.krossbooking.com and depends on outbound HTTPS; if run offline the assertion still holds as long as the adapter returns a Kross/login-related error rather than 'Errore generico'. Frontend: the ical-server pytest starts a socket on 127.0.0.1 which is not reachable from the browser context — that's fine, only the backend needs to reach it. If a stray /tmp http.server is needed for FE Playwright test, remember /tmp is not persistent across pod restarts.
